fractional-ownership-vs-timeshare.title: Fractional Ownership vs Timeshare — The Complete Buyer's Guide [2026]
fractional-ownership-vs-timeshare.subtitle: Two products with similar surface appeal and fundamentally different fundamentals. The deeded-asset / right-to-use distinction is the whole game.
fractional-ownership-vs-timeshare.metaDescription: Fractional ownership and timeshare are often confused but are fundamentally different. Fractional gives you a deeded share of real property held in an LLC; timeshare gives you a contractual right to use. This 2026 buyer's guide compares them across legal structure, appreciation, costs, exit, scheduling, and inheritance.

fractional-ownership-vs-second-home.title: Fractional Ownership vs Buying a Second Home Outright [2026]
fractional-ownership-vs-second-home.h1: Fractional Ownership vs Buying a Second Home Outright
fractional-ownership-vs-second-home.subtitle: The strongest buyer objection: "Why not just buy it all?" The honest answer depends on how many days a year you'll actually use the property and how the capital you don't tie up could be working elsewhere.
fractional-ownership-vs-second-home.metaDescription: Should you buy a whole second home or a 1/8 fractional share? This 2026 guide compares total cost of ownership, capital efficiency, usage patterns, opportunity cost, and exit flexibility, with worked examples in Marbella, Mallorca, and Megève.

pacaso-vs-myne.title: Pacaso vs MYNE Homes — Co-Ownership Operator Comparison [2026]
pacaso-vs-myne.subtitle: Two of the most prominent fractional co-ownership operators, with very different geographic strengths, operational models, and buyer profiles.
pacaso-vs-myne.metaDescription: Pacaso vs MYNE Homes: an operational comparison of the two leading fractional co-ownership platforms. Covers geographic coverage, share structures, fees, resale, rental policy, and financing across both partners.

pacaso-vs-vivla.title: Pacaso vs Vivla — Co-Ownership Operator Comparison [2026]
pacaso-vs-vivla.subtitle: Pacaso brings the largest cross-border footprint in fractional co-ownership; Vivla goes deeper in Spain than anyone. They serve different buyers — sometimes the same buyer at different moments.
pacaso-vs-vivla.metaDescription: Pacaso vs Vivla: an operational comparison of the US-origin global fractional operator and the Spain-deep European specialist. Coverage, fees, resale, financing, rental, and the buyer profile each serves best.

myne-vs-vivla.title: MYNE Homes vs Vivla — Co-Ownership Operator Comparison [2026]
myne-vs-vivla.subtitle: Two European-headquartered fractional operators with overlapping Spanish footprints and very different philosophies. MYNE goes broad across nine countries; Vivla goes deep in one.
myne-vs-vivla.metaDescription: MYNE Homes vs Vivla: operational comparison of two European fractional co-ownership operators. Coverage, share structures, fees, resale, rental, financing, and which suits Mediterranean second-home buyers best.
